curationMethod: Independent retrospective research questions grounded only in the original FAA source-claim IDs; annotated after the fact. The model sees only initially visible question and scope, never future transitions. Date-only source eligibility is not archived PIT.

tracks.question: Has the FAA approved the inspection and maintenance process needed for the grounded Boeing 737-9 MAX aircraft to become eligible to return to service?
tracks.scope: Boeing 737-9 MAX approval of return-to-service inspection procedures, distinct from completed inspections on each aircraft

transitions.interpretation: FAA required additional Boeing data before approving the process. At the January 12 release the inspection-and-maintenance process was not approved.
transitions.stillUnknown: FAA approval of inspection procedures and completion of aircraft-specific inspections

transitions.interpretation: FAA announced approval of inspection and maintenance procedures; grounded 737-9 MAX aircraft could become eligible for return to service after completion, but this is not proof that every aircraft actually completed inspections.
transitions.stillUnknown: Aircraft-by-aircraft completion, operational restoration and independent inspection outcomes

tracks.question: What official decisions and audit findings establish the progress and completion of the FAA's Boeing production and supplier quality oversight?
tracks.scope: Boeing MAX production line and supplier audit, separate from inspection procedure approval and actual audit completion

transitions.interpretation: FAA announced it would audit the Boeing 737-9 MAX production line and suppliers, but audit findings and conclusion had not been announced.
transitions.stillUnknown: Completed FAA production quality audit findings, supplier-compliance review and final oversight assessment

transitions.interpretation: FAA announced it would not grant MAX production expansion while increasing oversight, a concrete regulatory restriction, but the original announcement still does not provide completed production-line audit findings.
transitions.stillUnknown: Full audit findings, corrective action verification and final production quality-control conclusions
